title: Decide with Jev: Turn AI Answers into Decisions with PHP Rules
content:
Jev can answer three questions about a draft, but the model should not decide what happens next. In episode 3 of Decide with Jev, we write a small PHP class that turns those answers into one label. When the answers are unclear, the draft goes to a person.

The post Decide with Jev: Turn AI Answers into Decisions with PHP Rules appeared first on Laravel News.
